On this leg: 5,600 miles, 612 hours under way and 63 hours on station, averaging 9.5 knots. For the whole voyage, the log counts 53,968 miles, 5,787 hours under way, 1,075 hours on station, 288 days at sea and 46 in port.
leg-V2413-end.spoken: Vema arrives in Miami. From the voyage log: A stop at Barbados for fuel. Fuel consumption was high, from adverse weather, currents, and very heavy marine growth on the bottom. On this leg: five thousand six hundred miles, six hundred twelve hours under way and sixty-three hours on station, averaging nine point five knots. For the whole voyage, the log counts fifty-three thousand nine hundred sixty-eight miles, five thousand seven hundred eighty-seven hours under way, one thousand seventy-five hours on station, two hundred eighty-eight days at sea and forty-six in port.

intro.caption: R/V Vema, Voyage 24, 1967: around the world, west-about.
intro.spoken: This is the research vessel Vema, on Voyage twenty-four, in nineteen sixty-seven. Lamont Geological Observatory's schooner is sailing around the world, west-about, and we follow her day by day.
